home.title: Navaro
home.fit: **Topical skincare, but with supplement-shaped trust signals — verify before pitching.** The routine described is unambiguously topical (apply, massage upward, peptide threads melt). But the trust badges read 100% Vegan Capsules, Non-GMO, GMP-Certified Facility, Gluten/Soy/Dairy Free — that is ingestible-supplement language, which suggests either an ingestible line alongside the topical or badge copy lifted from one. Worth resolving before creative, because a supplement line would pull in the compliance surface DESIGN.md §1 chose this category to avoid. Claim caution: 'Clinically Inspired Formula' is doing deliberate work — inspired by, not proven by.
